name: John Thune

issue_poll.name: Emerson College/The Hill/KELOLAND South Dakota poll, Oct 19–21, 2022; Pew Research Center national survey, Oct 10–16, 2022
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–4 from Emerson's South Dakota most-important-issue question (economy 45%, threats to democracy 15%, abortion access 12%, health care 10%); 'threats to democracy' mapped to elections/voting. Health care, immigration, education, crime and housing were each under 10% with no published figures. Ranks 5–10 are the next issues in Pew's national 'very important' list (https://www.pewresearch.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/20/2022/10/PP_2022.10.20_midterms-economy_REPORT.pdf); immigration and foreign policy tied at 54%.

issues.position: Block new IRS enforcement hiring and audits under $400K
issues.note: The debt-limit deal rescinded about $1.4B of new IRS funding. Vote source: https://southdakotasearchlight.com/2023/06/02/congressional-roundup-sd-delegation-unanimous-in-support-for-debt-limit-deal/

issues.position: Keep state voter ID laws; oppose federal control of elections; keep filibuster
issues.note: Democratic federal voting bills got no floor vote; the SAVE America Act (RC 57, 2026) cuts both ways, so it is left unscored as in ar-boozman.

issues.position: National ban after 15 weeks; earlier limits left to states

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed
Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: No 15-week ban got a floor vote. S.6 vote source: https://www.usquery.com/vote/1190100011

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of the student loan debt relief rule (CRA)
votes.question: On passage

issues.position: Open federal lands to oil and gas; restore year-round E15
issues.note: H.R.1 required onshore and offshore oil and gas lease sales; year-round E15 got no floor vote.

issues.position: Keep Title 42 border expulsions in place
issues.note: Title 42 expired in May 2023 with no Senate floor vote on keeping it.

issues.position: Keep funding military and humanitarian aid to Ukraine

votes.bill_title: National Security Supplemental (Ukraine, Israel, Taiwan aid)
votes.question: On passage

caveats: Emerson published only four South Dakota issues, so ranks 5–10 rely on national Pew data.
No campaign issues page could be fetched and Thune held one debate; positions come from debate coverage, a KELOLAND race profile and 2022 Senate releases.
Elections left unscored: the SAVE America Act fits his voter-ID stance but is a federal election mandate, matching the ar-boozman call.
Economy scored only on the debt-limit deal's IRS rescission, a small part of that bill.
Roll call numbers 146, 135, 211, 372 and 48 come from other researched files; his S.4554 Nay is inferred from the party-line tally, not a member list.
